descriptionChirho: A feminine noun denoting a possession or inheritance, specifically landed property received as a divine grant or national heritage, used of the promised land given to Israel (Exodus 6:8, Deuteronomy 33:4, Ezekiel 11:15, 25:4, 33:24, 36:2-3). Both clusters convey the same meaning — prepositional 'as a possession' (eng: as possession, spa: como posesión / por posesión, hin: विरासत करके, arb: مِيرَاثًا, kor: 상속물로, swa: kuwa urithi) and absolute 'inheritance' (eng: inheritance, spa: herencia, hin: विरासत, arb: مِيرَاثًا, swa: urithi).
